com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.x509.CertificateBinding

Packages that use CertificateBinding
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509
X.509 client certificate authentication: a certificate presented on a dedicated TLS port, or forwarded by a trusted reverse proxy in a header, signs in the user it is bound to (by the SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate) at POST /login/x509, the form of the login page, with the CSRF token.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.x509
Use cases of X.509 client certificate sign-in: resolving a certificate fingerprint to an account, binding a certificate to an account and unbinding it.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.x509
X.509 client certificates as a sign-in method: the binding of a certificate to an account and the port that stores it.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.x509
JDBC adapter of X.509 client certificate sign-in: the certificates bound to accounts.
